[[File:Valley_of_Royalty_artifacts.jpg|thumb|200px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] viewing [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] processing artifacts from the Valley of Royalty.]]

The '''Valley of Royalty''' was an ancient valley on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] where the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] buried many of their most celebrated rulers who championed space exploration,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> including [[Rana Mas Trehalt]]. There were many secret catacombs and caves in the Valley, hiding a wealth of both historical information and valuables. 

The valley was listed as one of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]] by the historian [[Vicendi]] in [[10,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Valley was flooded with toxic waste when the [[Tiercam Dam]] broke, almost killing several Duros archaeologists. 

It was abandoned by [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] due to acidic pollution.<ref name="TEA" />
